stats.empty: Play your first game and the numbers start here.

rules.title: Rules
rules.hero_sub: Upload a game's rulebook and ask like you would at the table. It only answers with what the rulebook says, and tells you the page.

rules.status_error_ai: Reading photos or scanned PDFs needs AI enabled on the server.
rules.status_error_quota: The AI has hit today's limit. Upload it again tomorrow.
rules.add_game_first: Add the game to your collection first.
rules.files: PDF or photos of the pages
rules.files_help: If they're photos, upload them in order. We keep the text, not the file.
rules.processing: Reading the rulebook page by page. Photos take a bit longer.
rules.promise: It only answers with what the rulebook says. If it's not there, it tells you.
rules.cross_lang: The rulebook is in {lang}: I answer in your language and quote the original page.
rules.placeholder: Can I trade on someone else's turn?
rules.not_found_help: Try asking another way or check the rulebook index. Better that than making up a rule.
rules.flag_thanks: Thanks. The group will see the warning.
